_readme: planning-weekly stage card (slice 0). Nine stages: steps 1-8 (talk) plus the alone clerk stage after step 8's code-read 'go'. The runner (system/parts/stage_runner.py) owns order, record, next/back, statusline. Stages carry NO 'prompt' key yet: the prompt files are written in slices A and B, and load_card refuses a card whose prompt file does not exist -- add each 'prompt' key in the slice that lands its file. Every check uses only kinds the runner knows (min_words, code_word; headings/forbid/require_sections/order/phase_gate available for later slices). The I4 gate vocabularies ('lock/next/B', 'again/refine/A', 'go' or 1-8) are the skill's own scripts/gates.py job (slice B), not new runner commands. Scratchpad sections are the one table in SKILL.md.

runner_waits.steps-1-3: on the person's rounds; the next question round waits for the world-model sharpener (failure shown, never skipped)
runner_waits.step-4: hard gate: opens only when step 2's week is confirmed AND the draft ranker's file is done
runner_waits.step-5: opens when the zone sorter's draft is done; on lock spins off the persist drafter and the Council
runner_waits.step-6: tensions shown as each advisor finishes; the person rules on each
runner_waits.step-7: rounds until the clap test; the write list saved at 7.7; nothing written yet
runner_waits.step-8: on the person's 'go', read by code (go, or a step number 1-8; anything else asked again)
runner_waits.clerk: alone stage: works the write list row by row, resumable; backup last, reported plainly if it failed

scratchpad_sections.writer: 2.7 (full week / lighter / much lighter; code turns it into hours)
each advisor (tensions only, never a new plan)

stages._gate: hard gate (spec S2.6): stage step-4 cannot open until this stage passes confirmed
next round waits for the world-model sharpener (I6); failure shown, never skipped
opens only when the draft ranker's finished file exists (S4.1) -- enforced by scripts/gates.py in slice B; the runner's own order check holds the step-2 confirmation gate
opens when the zone sorter's draft is done (5.2); on lock spins off the persist drafter (5.8, for step 7) and the Council (step 6's first move)
tensions shown as each advisor finishes (I9); person rules on each with RULING lines
rounds until the clap test; write list saved at 7.7; nothing written yet
8.5 'go' read by code: 'go' or a step number 1-8 (I4); anything else asked again. Going back marks later sections stale (I8)

stages._note: the alone write stage: works the scratchpad write list row by row through gc answer/gc decide/gc backup, reads each write back, marks each row as it lands (resumable); backup last
